proposed.text: What is the minimum floor area per unit for both socialized and economic housing under BP 220?

options.text: Socialized = 28 sqm; Economic = 72 sqm, which is typically required for larger family units
Both = 30 sqm, as mandated for mixed-use developments
Socialized = 22 sqm; Economic = 42 sqm, often applied in urban redevelopment zones

rationale.a: Correct per BP 220 Revised IRR Table 7: Socialized minimum floor area = 18 sqm, Economic minimum floor area = 24 sqm for all housing types (single detached, duplex, row house).
rationale.b: These are minimum LOT areas (socialized SD = 64 sqm, economic SD = 72 sqm), not floor areas.
rationale.c: There is no 30 sqm minimum floor area; socialized and economic have different floor area minimums.
rationale.d: Neither value is correct per BP 220; socialized = 18 sqm, economic = 24 sqm.
rationale.correct: BP 220 Revised IRR specifies minimum FLOOR area: Socialized = 18 sqm per unit; Economic = 24 sqm per single-family dwelling unit. Lot areas differ: socialized SD = 64 sqm, economic SD = 72 sqm.
rationale.takeaway: Distinguish floor area minimums (18/24 sqm) from lot area minimums (64/72 sqm) when answering BP 220 questions.
